page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.s2.large is an x86_64 architecture virtual machine instance within the ecs.s2 server family, running on the KVM hypervisor. This instance is configured with 2 dedicated vCPUs and 4.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include any local NVMe or SSD storage, requiring network-attached storage for boot volumes and data persistence.

The dedicated CPU allocation ensures that the virtual cores are not shared with other tenants, providing consistent compute access. However, the processor lacks support for advanced instruction sets, including Advanced Vector Extensions (AVX, AVX512), Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX), and hardware-accelerated cryptography flags such as AES and SHA_NI. The absence of hyper-threading and virtualization extensions limits its utility for nested virtualization or highly parallelized vector workloads.

This server type does not feature any GPU acceleration or complimentary public IPv4 addresses. Given the low memory-to-CPU ratio and the lack of specialized hardware accelerators, the ecs.s2.large is structured for lightweight, non-vectorized workloads. Appropriate use cases include basic web serving, lightweight application hosting, small-scale development environments, and simple utility tasks that do not require high memory capacity or advanced instruction sets.

It is qualitatively positioned as a cost-efficient option for lightweight utility tasks, small-scale development environments, and basic web serving that do not demand high memory density or specialized hardware acceleration.
